outline: 本課程旨在強化學生口語表達及溝通能力，開拓知識領域以及培養學生的國際觀。由逐步短句，段落至長途步口譯，循序漸進。從入門訣竅如讀稿技巧，筆記要領密集訓練及模擬演練。範圍涵蓋經貿，金融，時事，科技，產業等。
schedule:
WEEK	SESSION THEME
1	Introduction
2     	Interpretation as a Profession
3     	Paraphrasing/Public speaking I
4     	Paraphrasing/Public speaking II
5    	Sight translation I (E-C)
6	Sight translation II (E-C)
7	Sight translation III (C-E)
8   	Sight translation IV (C-E)
9    	Mid-term
10    	Memory retention/Recall exercises I
11    	Memory retention/Recall exercises II
12   	Short CI on general topics I
13   	Short CI on general topics II
14   	Note-taking for CI: Skills and strategies I
15   	Note-taking for CI: Skills and strategies II
16   	Note-taking for CI: Skills and strategies III*
17   	Wrap-up
18   	Final

*More CI training shall continue in the spring term 2013
assessment:
Attendance
ATTENDANCE IS MANDATORY. Students who miss more than 4 class sessions fail the course.
Assessment
	30% on mid-term examination
	30% on final examination
	40% on continual assessments: attendance to lectures; presentations; in-class performance; homework
